description: Defects planted into a staged copy of the fixture, each an exact-string edit, to ask one mechanical question of a candidate suite: does it go red? Every one sits on the far side of a conversion, a sequence or a silent fallback, so the shipped suite stays green against all of them. That is deliberate: the control arm has to fail this casebook before any asset is measured against it.

defects.title: An amount on exactly half a minor unit truncates instead of rounding up
defects.rationale: 1.005 posts as 1.00 rather than 1.01. Every amount a caller is likely to try rounds the same either way, so only a test pinning the half-unit boundary itself sees it.

defects.title: A negative amount loses its sign before rounding
defects.replace: return -(minor - 1) if negative and minor else minor
defects.rationale: Debits come back a minor unit short. A suite that only posts credits never evaluates the branch, and one that posts a round debit like -10.00 gets a wrong answer that still looks like money.

defects.title: An unpriced currency is accepted at the default rate instead of refused
defects.find:
priced = currency in RATES
    effective = currency if priced else DEFAULT_CURRENCY
defects.replace:
priced = True
    effective = currency if currency in RATES else DEFAULT_CURRENCY
defects.rationale: The response stops admitting the amount was never priced, so a caller cannot tell a real rate from a fallback. Nothing raises, so an assertion that the call did not throw passes.

defects.title: A reversed entry is not marked, so it can be reversed twice
defects.rationale: Reversing the same entry twice subtracts it twice, and the running balance then disagrees with a rebuild from the postings. A test that posts and reverses once cannot reach it.

defects.title: Re-posting the same entry id applies it again
defects.rationale: A retrying caller double-counts. The defect needs the same id posted twice in one test, which is a sequence a single-call test never builds.

defects.title: Cross-currency conversion truncates instead of rounding
defects.rationale: Converted postings land a minor unit light whenever the conversion falls on or above a half unit. A test asserting the converted balance is positive, or merely non-zero, is blind to it.
